name: Street Pursuit
author: Addicting Games
description: Street Pursuit is a free racing game. In this racing game, you'll have to be quick, nimble, and out-think the cops as you twist and turn your way through a suburban maze of hedges, walls, houses, and barricades set up to stop you in your tracks. Try to collect as much cash as you can in order to unlock better cars and new levels. Beware the police cars that freckle the landscape and will try to smash into you and take you down. Each hit from a cop won't slow you down too much but it will remove some money from your stash and that is the whole point f this game! You can collect power-ups like shields which let you smash cop cars without any issue. You can collect a snowflake that freezes all the cops in lace or you can hit an explosive device that blows up all the opposing vehicles ad turns them into money for you to collect. This game is for the quick of heart and the fast of wheel. Do not let the man get you down as you avoid their barricades and dodge their attacks. This is not a game of smash em' up because whenever you smash you lose cash. Be quick, be nimble, and get rich in this fast-paced game.
